algorithm.title: Metabolic syndrome diagnostic criteria and management

nodes.text: Patient with central obesity: screen for metabolic syndrome criteria (requires >= 3 of 5 components)
Components: waist > 88 cm (women), BP >= 130/85, fasting glucose >= 100, TG >= 150, HDL < 50
Confirm diagnosis: patient exhibits obesity, hypertension, and fasting hyperglycemia
Prescribe comprehensive lifestyle modification: weight loss + 150 minutes weekly aerobic exercise
**Persistent hypertension >= 130/80:** initiate antihypertensive therapy with ACE inhibitor or ARB
**Persistent fasting hyperglycemia >= 126 mg/dL:** initiate metformin therapy
